RDB.name: Rwanda Development Board

RRA.name: Rwanda Revenue Authority

NLA.name: National Land Authority
NLA.does: E-titles, adding or removing a spouse in the land register, merging plots

RURA.name: Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Authority
RURA.does: Authorisations for passenger and goods vehicles, and their suspension

RNP.name: Rwanda National Police

CIV.name: Civil registration and identity
